title: Prep Notes, Week 6
dek: Jeremiyah Love is out, so Tyler Allgeier is RB23 for me; Lamar Jackson and Rashee Rice sit too, and Dameon Pierce has the Philadelphia backfield.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Updated Fri 7:20 PM ET: Buffalo and Las Vegas posted Friday's report. Ashton Jeanty (full all week) and Brock Bowers (full Thursday and Friday) have no designation and stay RB13 and TE1 for me. DJ Moore was limited Friday and is questionable @LV; monitor Sunday's inactives at 2:55 PM ET.

Friday's final reports are in for Week 6. Eight fantasy players are out, nobody we play is doubtful, and eight are questionable. Jeremiyah Love, Lamar Jackson and Rashee Rice are out, so Tyler Allgeier is RB23 for me and an RB2, Tyler Huntley starts in Baltimore, and Xavier Worthy is WR30. Saquon Barkley and Will Shipley are both out, which hands the Philadelphia backfield to Dameon Pierce at RB20. Rankings are for full PPR.

Cleared with no designation: Michael Penix Jr., DeVonta Smith, Zay Flowers, KC Concepcion, Josh Downs and CeeDee Lamb. The true Sunday decisions are Quinshon Judkins, Tyler Warren, DK Metcalf and A.J. Brown; Caleb Williams, Chris Olave and Alvin Kamara are questionable but practiced Friday. Brock Bowers and Ashton Jeanty have no designation for Las Vegas, and DJ Moore is questionable for Buffalo after a limited Friday. Washington and San Francisco post theirs Saturday for Monday night, with Mike Evans (ribs, Achilles) and Terry McLaurin (hamstring) the names to check.
outro_md: Order Up has the inactives Sunday morning, starting with London at 8:00 AM ET.

report.read: Mike LaFleur confirmed he will not play @LAR after a week without practice. Tyler Allgeier had 60 percent of the snaps in Weeks 1 and 2 and takes the goal-line work.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Tyler Allgeier, RB23 for me this week, an RB2.

report.read: He has not practiced since the Oct. 4 injury, and Jesse Minter called sitting him a decision for his best interest. Tyler Huntley starts @CLE.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Kirk Cousins, QB13 for me vs BUF, a borderline start this week.

report.read: Ruled out and did not travel to London. Woody Marks played 56 of 65 snaps at TEN after Montgomery left.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Woody Marks, RB19 for me @JAX, an RB2.

report.read: No practice all week after the bye; Kansas City ruled him out vs LAC. Xavier Worthy is the top outside receiver.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Xavier Worthy, WR30 for me, a high-end WR3 and a high-end flex play.

report.read: Out a third straight game. Braelon Allen played all but two snaps the last time Hall sat.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Braelon Allen, RB18 for me @NE, an RB2.

report.read: No practice all week, and Will Shipley (foot) is out too. Dameon Pierce led Philadelphia with 11 carries in Week 5 and is the last healthy back with a role.
report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Dameon Pierce, RB20 for me vs CAR, an RB2.

report.verdict: Out. Pivot to Tyler Shough, QB12 for me @NYG, a borderline start this week.

report.verdict: Out. Pivot to C.J. Stroud, QB14 for me @JAX, a borderline start this week.

report.read: Three full practices, but he said he does not know yet if he will play and still needs a stress test. The pattern says he plays @ATL.
report.verdict: QB8 for me this week. Have Kirk Cousins (QB13) ready in case Chicago's inactives surprise at 11:30 AM ET.

report.verdict: RB35 for me if he is active, a low-end RB3 and a low-end flex play. Monitor; Cleveland's inactives at 11:30 AM ET.

report.verdict: TE8 for me if he plays. Monitor; Indianapolis's inactives at 11:30 AM ET, with Juwan Johnson (TE9) as the fallback.

report.read: Limited all week in his 21-day window off IR; New England has to activate him by Saturday at 4:00 PM ET.
report.verdict: He has not played since the high ankle sprain, and in his first game back he is a dart throw at most. Monitor; Saturday's roster moves at 4:00 PM ET.
report.watch: Saturday's roster moves at 4:00 PM ET

report.read: The illness kept him out Wednesday and Thursday, and he was back on the field Friday. An illness does not linger the way a hamstring does.
report.verdict: WR6 for me this week; check New Orleans' inactives at 11:30 AM ET.

report.read: Full Thursday and Friday after missing three games. Jaylen Warren has topped 126 total yards three straight games.
report.verdict: Unranked this week, and Jaylen Warren stays RB6 for me @TB. Sit Dowdle in his first game back.

report.read: An illness kept him out Friday after full days Wednesday and Thursday. Germie Bernard ran 32 routes on 34 dropbacks vs IND.
report.verdict: WR26 for me if he plays, a high-end WR3. Monitor; Pittsburgh's inactives at 11:30 AM ET, with Germie Bernard (WR34) the fallback.

report.read: Missed the Wednesday walkthrough and Thursday, then was limited Friday with the AC joint sprain. He sat Week 5 @LAR off one limited session, and Keon Coleman caught a TD without him.
report.verdict: Monitor; Sunday's inactives at 2:55 PM ET. Keon Coleman is WR39 for me @LV, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.
